typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Fact_table as string,
	G_Run_Eff_DT as timestamp,
	G_Run_End_DT as timestamp
}
source(output(
		dw_agg_key as integer,
		iostatus as string,
		IOStatusCnt as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~> OLESRCFACT
OLESRCFACT pivot(groupBy(dw_agg_key),
	pivotBy(iostatus, ['IOStatusCnt']),
	IOStatusCnt = avg(IOStatusCnt),
	columnNaming: '$N_$V',
	lateral: true) ~> Pivot
Pivot split(!(isNull(Entry)) && !(isNull(Exit)) && Entry == Exit,
	disjoint: true) ~> CSPLEnEX@(ValidEntries, InvalidEntries)
CSPLEnEX@ValidEntries sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'parquet',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		dw_agg_key,
		IOStatusCnt_IOStatusCnt
	)) ~> CMDAGGFACT
